title: Checking hairpin and adapter DNA [DAF-SELEX]
body:
### 1. Hairpin & Adapter DNA check

Loading order for gel:

- 50 bp DNA ladder
- Hairpin non-annealed (1 uL)
- Hairpin annealed (8 uL)
- Adapter A (1 uL)
- Adapter B (1 uL)
- Adapter A+B (8 uL)
- 50 bp DNA ladder
- NEB 100 bp DNA ladder
- TriDye 100 bp DNA ladder

*Sample Preparation*


| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| TBE Hi-Density Sample Buffer (5X) | 2 uL |
| Sample | Make up to 10 uL |

- Run the gel at 150 V, 10 mins prior to loading samples.
- Run the gel at 150 V, 45 mins with constant checking of the dye front.
- Stain the gel for an hour with SYBR Green stain (prepared in 1X TBE)
